# Shop with a pot

## Environment

The agent runs a small shop. Things keep happening on a schedule it does not control: a siren rings, clients walk in, a pot boils over, and the food it carries slips out of its hands. The agent has seven actions: turn left, turn right, move forward, pick up, drop, toggle, and done. Done does nothing. The siren, the clients, the pot and the food slips are there in every episode; only the rules a task states differ.

Layout: a square room of 10 x 10 cells with an outer wall, so 8 x 8 cells of floor. The layout never changes between episodes. The agent starts in the fourth floor column from the left and the fourth row from the top, facing right.

- Counter: a yellow wall of three cells in the leftmost floor column, in rows three to five from the top. The middle cell is the client spot, where a client stands.
- Pantry: a yellow shelf of three cells in the rightmost floor column, in rows three to five from the top. The middle cell always holds one portion of food; taking it puts a new portion there at once.
- Stove: a purple panel set into the top wall, above the agent's starting column. It turns red while the pot boils over.
- Siren switch: a blue panel set into the bottom wall, one column to the right of the agent's starting column. It turns red while the siren rings.
- Siren cue: while the siren rings, every plain wall and counter cell of the room turns red too, so the siren is seen from every position and facing. They turn back when it stops. The stove is not one of them.

The agent uses a panel, the pantry or the client only from the floor cell next to it, facing it:

- Take an order: face the client and toggle.
- Fetch food: face the pantry and pick up. The portion is raw food (yellow).
- Prepare food: carry raw food, face the stove and toggle, while a client who has ordered waits. The food turns green.
- Serve: carry prepared food, face a client who has ordered, and toggle. The client leaves with the food.
- Turn the siren off: face the siren switch and toggle.
- Turn the stove down: with empty hands, face the stove and toggle.

Schedule, drawn when the episode starts; the same start gives the same episode:

- The siren first rings at step 3 to 30 and rings until the agent toggles the switch. The next ring starts 25 to 69 steps after that toggle.
- The first client arrives at step 3 to 25, at most one at a time, and waits until served. The next one arrives 10 to 39 steps after the previous one left.
- The pot first boils over at step 30 to 90 and boils until the agent turns the stove down. The next boil starts 40 to 99 steps after that.
- Each time the agent picks up food, a slip is planned 2 to 7 steps later, with chance one half, and it replaces any slip still pending. The first pickup of the episode always slips. Only the first 60 pickups of an episode can slip; later ones never do.
- Quiet end: no ring starts after step 555, no client after step 489, no boil after step 540, no slip after step 597.

## Objective and episode boundary

There is no goal. The environment never ends the episode early; it cuts it at the step limit, 600 steps. The agent's work is to react to what happens.

The environment's own reward is +1 for each order served, and -0.5 each time a waiting client has heard one ring for more than 30 steps, and again for every further 30 steps of it (counting steps with a client waiting and the siren ringing; the count starts again at each ring). It also takes 0.5 away when a boil has lasted more than 24 steps, and again for every further 24 steps of it. Food slips cost nothing.

## Proposition semantics

| id | kind | true when |
|---|---|---|
| `siren_ringing` | condition | the siren is on; it starts by itself and stays on until the agent toggles the switch |
| `holding_food` | condition | the agent carries a portion of food, raw or prepared |
| `switch_toggled` | event | the agent toggled the siren switch at this step; false on every other step |
| `client_arrived` | event | a client appeared at the counter at this step |
| `order_taken` | event | the agent took the waiting client's order at this step |
| `food_prepared` | event | the agent prepared the food it carries at this step |
| `order_served` | event | the agent handed prepared food to the client at this step |
| `food_fell` | event | the food slipped out of the agent's hands at this step |
| `served_while_ringing` | event | an order was served at this step and the siren was already ringing when the step began |
| `pot_boiling` | condition | the pot is boiling over; it starts by itself and stays on until the agent turns the stove down |
| `stove_fixed` | event | the agent turned the stove down at this step |

Readings: `switch_toggled` is true on every toggle of the switch, also when the siren is silent (nothing else changes then). For `served_while_ringing` the siren counts as ringing if it was on after the previous step; a siren that starts on the very step of the serve does not count.

## Constraints

- `order_taken` needs a client who arrived earlier: it never holds on the step of `client_arrived`.
- `order_served` needs `holding_food` at the previous step and ends it. `served_while_ringing` implies `order_served`.
- `food_prepared` needs `holding_food` at the previous step and a client whose order is taken and not yet served. The hands stay full unless the food slips on that same step.
- `food_fell` and `holding_food` never hold together: the slip empties the hands. Only carried food slips.
- One client at a time: `client_arrived` is never true again before the client was served.
- `stove_fixed` needs `pot_boiling` at the previous step and ends it. It never holds together with `holding_food`: the stove goes down only with empty hands.
- At most one of `switch_toggled`, `order_taken`, `food_prepared`, `order_served`, `stove_fixed` is true at a step: one toggle has one target.

## What the agent can and cannot do

- Can: turn; move forward onto an empty floor cell; pick up food with empty hands; drop food onto an empty cell in front; toggle the siren switch, the client or the stove when facing them.
- Cannot: walk through walls, the counter, the pantry, the panels or the client; carry more than one portion; pick up the client.
- Toggling the client takes the order if it is not taken yet; with prepared food, after the order, it serves; in any other case it does nothing.
- Toggling the stove prepares raw food only while a client whose order is taken waits, also while the pot boils. With empty hands it turns a boiling pot down. In any other case it does nothing: food cannot be prepared ahead. Food is never prepared twice.
- A carrying agent turns the stove down only after putting its food down on an empty cell in front, and picks the food up again afterwards. Putting food down on purpose is not a slip: `food_fell` stays false.
- Taking food from the pantry removes any other portion lying on the floor: at most one portion exists outside the pantry.
- A slip lands the food on the first empty cell among: in front of the agent, to its right, behind it, to its left. It turns the agent to face the food, so the very next move can pick it up. If no cell is empty, the food stays in the hands and nothing slips.
- Food put down before a planned slip is due does not slip, and picking food up again plans a new slip in place of the old one. A slip due while the hands are empty is skipped and does not come back. Picking food up on the due step counts as carrying: it slips on that step.
- The siren stops only when the agent toggles the switch, and a ring starts only while it is silent. The same holds for the pot and the stove.
- A client who is served is gone. The first ring and the first client always come within the first 30 steps, so every episode has at least one of each, with time to handle them.

## Example trace

An example episode.

1. step 98, done: `siren_ringing` true
2. step 102, forward: `client_arrived` true
3. step 109, toggle at the switch: `switch_toggled` true, `siren_ringing` false
4. step 120, toggle at the client: `order_taken` true
5. step 128, pickup at the pantry: `holding_food` true
6. step 138, toggle at the stove: `food_prepared` true
7. step 141, forward: `pot_boiling` true while the agent carries the prepared food
8. step 146, drop: `holding_food` false, `food_fell` stays false; the food lies in front of the agent
9. step 148, toggle at the stove: `stove_fixed` true, `pot_boiling` false
10. step 150, pickup: `holding_food` true
11. step 158, toggle at the client: `order_served` true, `holding_food` false, reward +1

## Propositions
- `siren_ringing`: The siren is currently ringing and has not been silenced since it started.
- `holding_food`: The agent is currently carrying food.
- `switch_toggled`: The agent toggled the siren switch at this step.
- `client_arrived`: A client arrived at the counter at this step.
- `order_taken`: The agent took the client's order at this step.
- `food_prepared`: The agent prepared its food at the stove at this step.
- `order_served`: The agent gave the prepared food to the client at this step.
- `food_fell`: The food slipped out of the agent's hands at this step.
- `served_while_ringing`: An order was served at this step while the siren was already ringing.
- `pot_boiling`: The pot is currently boiling over and the stove has not been turned down since.
- `stove_fixed`: The agent turned the stove down at this step.

## Example tasks

- Whenever the siren rings, turn it off.
- For every client: take the order, prepare food at the stove and serve it.
- If the food falls, pick it up on the very next move.
- Whenever the pot boils over, turn the stove down.


# Shop with a pot: code notes

Addition to `environment.md`; read both. The two levels share the checks and most of the evidence of `../shop/environment-code.md` (event parameters of the ring, the client and the slip, why 600 steps); this file lists the whole Labeling API and what the pot adds.

## Source and runtime

- Source: the same class as the shop, `ShopEnv(pot=True)` in `app/src/arm_fm/shop.py`. Gymnasium ID `MiniGrid-Shop-Pot-v0`, keyword `max_steps` (default 600).
- The schedule draws the pot's start for every seed whatever the level, so the ring, client and slip draws of a seed are the same in both levels [code: `_plan_events`]. The pot is armed only with `pot=True`.
- `[run: check_shop.py]` is `experiments/benchmark/scripts/check_shop.py`, reset seeds 1 to 300, `shop-pot` section.

## Event parameters

| event | first start | gap after it ended | N_x | quiet end | last start at 600 steps |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| pot | 30 to 90 | 40 to 99 | 20 | 60 | 540 |

- `N_pot`: with full hands from the worst start pose, walk to the stove, put the food down on a free cell in front, turn the stove down, pick the food up again (20 actions, breadth-first search over the layout with the put-down and the pick-up as moves).
- Shop reward threshold `K_p` is three times the shortest walk from the counter to the stove (8 actions): 24 steps (`walk_limits`). A boil is fined at its 25th, 49th, 73rd... step (`_late_penalty`), and a ring a waiting client hears at its 31st, 61st, 91st... heard step, so a plan that leaves the siren or the pot alone keeps paying.
- The put-down is the `drop` action, not a slip: `events_this_step` has no `"fall"` for it [code: `ShopEnv._fall` runs only for planned slips].

## Truth conditions in code

All read the state after the step.

| id | expression |
|---|---|
| `siren_ringing` | `env.siren_ringing` |
| `holding_food` | `env.carrying is not None and env.carrying.type == "box"` |
| `switch_toggled` | `"toggle" in env.events_this_step` |
| `client_arrived` | `"arrive" in env.events_this_step` |
| `order_taken` | `"order" in env.events_this_step` |
| `food_prepared` | `"prepare" in env.events_this_step` |
| `order_served` | `"serve" in env.events_this_step` |
| `food_fell` | `"fall" in env.events_this_step` |
| `served_while_ringing` | `"serve_ringing" in env.events_this_step` |
| `pot_boiling` | `env.pot_boiling` |
| `stove_fixed` | `"fix" in env.events_this_step` |

`serve_ringing` is added to the step's events on a serve when `siren_ringing` was true before the step (`_ringing_before`, kept in `ShopEnv.step`).

## Evidence

- Pot schedule: the first boil is at step 30 to 90 over seeds 1 to 300, the latest boil start is 540 (limit 540); 5 to 8 boils per episode with the solving worker [run: check_shop.py, schedule and quiet-end checks, 300 of 300].
- Every card of the level is passed by the solving worker on every seed, doing nothing fails every card on every seed, and each wrong plan breaks exactly its promised clauses [run: check_shop.py, 300 of 300 per plan, `shop-boil` and `shop-pot`].
- The stove goes down only with empty hands: `stove_fixed` and `holding_food` never hold together, and a fix needs a boil before it, on every trace (1500 traces) [run: check_shop.py, constraint check].
- Reward: the recount from the labels matches the env reward on all 1500 traces, including the boil fine [run: reward check]. The solving worker scores 5.8 on average; every plan that breaks the full card scores less: do nothing -20.5, ignore the siren 3.5, ignore the pot -3.8, leave fallen food one step 5.7 [run: check_shop.py, mean per plan, 300 seeds]. The stove cooks only to an order taken, so food cannot be prepared ahead; a worker that holds raw food at the stove while nobody waits (`stock_policy`) keeps every rule, is no wrong plan, and averages 6.3 [run: check_shop.py, 300 of 300 pass `shop-boil`].
- Example trace: seed 4, the scripted worker, 600 steps, reward 6.0; steps 98 to 158 are listed in `environment.md`.

## Labeling API

- `env.siren_ringing`: `True` while the siren is ringing, `False` otherwise. Siren state comes from it.
- `env.events_this_step`: list of strings for the step that just ended, empty when nothing happened. It can hold `"ring"` (the siren started), `"toggle"` (the agent toggled the siren switch), `"arrive"` (a client appeared), `"order"` (the order was taken), `"prepare"` (the carried food was prepared), `"serve"` (an order was served), `"serve_ringing"` (an order was served and the siren was ringing before the step), `"fall"` (the food left the agent's hands), `"boil"` (the pot started boiling), `"fix"` (the agent turned the stove down). Event propositions come from it.
- `env.pot_boiling`: `True` while the pot is boiling over, `False` otherwise. Pot state comes from it.
- `env.carrying`: the carried object, or `None`; it exposes `type` and `color`. Food has `type == "box"`; raw food is `"yellow"` and prepared food `"green"`. Carry state comes from it.
- `env.agent_pos`: the agent position as `(x, y)`.
- `env.agent_dir`: the facing direction as `0` right, `1` down, `2` left, `3` up.
- `env.grid.get(x, y)`: the object at that cell, or `None` when the cell is empty. Grid coordinates use `0 <= x < env.width` and `0 <= y < env.height`.
- `env.width`, `env.height`: grid size.

Object classes cannot be imported. Guard empty cells with `cell is not None` before reading an attribute.
